scope: All 118 data rows and 1,026 printed numeric entries, with independent aggregation of approved low-level, confirmation/development, PID and PID-reproduction scalar case records.
source_path_base: Repository root passed through --root; never a private session directory

tex.origin: New approved renderer output; never copy the original TeX

numeric_input_projection.publication_authorization_owner: parent final scope/export process, not numeric validation

tex_locator_note: Pass required --tex with the NEW numeric table TeX locator. Original TeX is neither required nor copied. The historical original TeX SHA256 remains metadata only; numeric-view bytes/layout intentionally differ.

CLI.input_map_schema: Plain JSON object from approved alias to repository-relative locator; no URLs, absolute paths, traversal, extra aliases or external symlinks
CLI.output: JSON on stdout; exit 0 only on complete pass, exit 1 on validation failure, exit 2 on CLI usage errors including missing --tex

hash_contract.recorded_source_sha256: Preserved original scientific-source digest, never overwritten by path normalization
hash_contract.observed_sha256: Digest of the actual approved input bytes used by this invocation
hash_contract.default: Validate scientific values, cohorts, source bindings, labels, emphasis and aggregations; report both byte digests and their equality.
hash_contract.strict_mode: Fail on any recorded numeric JSON source byte-hash mismatch. There are 13 such input files; generated TeX is checked numerically, not against original document bytes.
hash_contract.generated_TeX: Record its derived SHA256; preserve the historical original TeX digest separately without enforcing byte/layout identity.
hash_contract.normalized_derivatives: Locator-only normalized reports may differ in bytes. Preserve original hashes, record derived hashes and the release transformation separately; numeric validation is not a replacement for a transformation receipt.
hash_contract.execution_commit_nulls: Explicit null execution commits for corrected SAC, BC, Guided SAC and PID mode reproduction are required and retained.

tests.integration_TeX: Fresh numeric-only TeX is generated in memory from the 13 approved result JSON inputs; no original TeX is read

explicit_non_dependencies: Original paper ZIP or full manuscript
Original comparison_data.json blob containing manuscript table_tex
Private session files or private trace inventories
Archived per-episode JSON and raw trace CSV/gzip
PDF readers, TeX executables or third-party Python packages
Network access or live public artifact URLs

aggregation_limits.archive_Q1: Frozen reported numeric means/SDs in the row map; only the narrow recorded legacy PID relief reproduction is cross-checked.
aggregation_limits.Q6_earlier_absolute_economic_four_rows: Report-bound values/counts/cash references are verified, but their archived individual episode traces are deliberately not required or recomputed.
aggregation_limits.PDF: The original approved nine-page PDF is retained as a frozen view. Numeric-only table generation does not regenerate the PDF or original layout/TeX bytes.

large_artifact_delivery.instruction: Supply the approved scalar reports at the declared relative locations, or use a relative input map. Missing local inputs cause a failure, never an assumed successful online fetch.
